description: Represents an excerpt of content returned alongside a detection.

data.description: The contextual excerpt of the content around the detection.
data.title: data

encryptedData.description: The original snippet data, encrypted, when apex masked values in it. Apex sets it, and only its decrypt endpoint can read it back. It is empty when nothing was masked, or when apex has no key to encrypt with.
encryptedData.title: encryptedData

end.description: The end position of the detection inside the snippet data.
end.title: end

start.description: The start position of the detection inside the snippet data.
start.title: start
